notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 26 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer2616cont), the 26 Saturday issues from 2 January to 26 June 1926. Every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR; entries whose heading names an East Bay city were set aside and the San Francisco ones kept, one finding per building (a tract entry listing several offsets becomes one finding per offset). An entry gives no street number for new work: it gives a side of a street and a distance from a cross street, or a corner. Each lot was built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names a corner whose parcel is unambiguous) and the roll dates the building 1925-1928. Alterations carry a printed street number and were matched exactly in sf-eas-addresses, accepted where the roll dates the building before 1926. Every accepted row that was published was then read against the page image, location first: the OCR drops or adds a digit in costs, garbles names and runs entries together at column breaks, and about 160 of the 385 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken.

coverage.remaining: Vol. 26 part 1 only; the other 33 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 26 part 2 (July-December 1926) next. In this volume: 543 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, wait on a decision about how many pages to seed (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 682 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside 1925-1928). 794 rows were not placed: 354 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 245 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 160 printed street numbers with no EAS row today, and the rest ambiguous. A few East Bay entries with no city in the heading are among the unplaced rows.
coverage.note: 4,373 numbered entries read, 2,404 San Francisco rows, 1,610 placed on a parcel, 385 picked and read against the page image, 368 published on 345 pages (242 seeded), 13 held back at the image check, 4 on parcels with no EAS address.
